# Dan Wilkinson

> Software engineer in North Yorkshire building simple websites and small apps for churches, charities and small businesses.

## Skill library for AI agents

- [Skill index (JSON)](https://danielpaulwilkinson.github.io/skills/index.json): every skill with a one-line "use it when" and its SKILL.md URL.
- [Skills llms.txt](https://danielpaulwilkinson.github.io/skills/llms.txt)

## Agent library

- [Agent index (JSON)](https://danielpaulwilkinson.github.io/agents/index.json): VS Code / GitHub Copilot custom agents with Claude Code variants, install paths, skills and handoffs.
